payload:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo='C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods-work-canonical'
Set-Location $repo
git fetch origin --prune
$current=(git branch --show-current | Out-String).Trim()
$head=(git rev-parse HEAD | Out-String).Trim()
$dirty=((git status --porcelain=v1 | Out-String).Trim().Length -gt 0)
$main=(git rev-parse origin/main | Out-String).Trim()
$rows=@()
$refs=git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)|%(committerdate:iso8601)|%(objectname)|%(subject)' refs/remotes/origin/
foreach($line in $refs){
  $p=$line -split '\|',4
  $ref=$p[0]
  if($ref -in @('origin/main','origin/HEAD')){continue}
  $counts=(git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...$ref | Out-String).Trim() -split '\s+'
  git merge-base --is-ancestor $ref origin/main 2>$null
  $merged=($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0)
  $rows += [ordered]@{branch=$ref.Substring(7);ahead=[int]$counts[1];behind=[int]$counts[0];merged=$merged;date=$p[1];sha=$p[2];subject=$p[3]}
}
[ordered]@{repo=$repo;current=$current;head=$head;dirty=$dirty;origin_main=$main;branches=$rows|Sort-Object @{Expression='ahead';Descending=$true},branch}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
